authorization_reference: MODEL_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.json (RRP-001-AUTH-001) for model execution on this host, plus the operator's standing session instruction recorded verbatim: 'if you need GPU for long running or short running fine tuning works go ahead and use them', and the follow-up 'continue with the arm once the baseline lands'. That authorizes FINE-TUNING COMPUTE, which is why this is the first lane in the programme whose excludes list omits 'training'. It does NOT constitute review of the training data and no such review is claimed: human_data_review stays NOT_PERFORMED and the data is MACHINE_VERIFIED_NOT_HUMAN_REVIEWED.
registered_predictions: Written before the run, in RRP003_ARM_A1_DESIGN.md section 6: P1 passes, P2 FAILS, format validity rises sharply, wrong_sentinel becomes measurable for the first time, and preservation risk is concentrated in abstention. If P1 passes and P2 fails the honest headline is 'the arm learned the response contract, which is not the task'.
scope: ONE bounded supervised fine-tuning arm on Forge v2 TRAIN, targeting the v2 response contract and its reasoning together, at the already-qualified 2048 training window. Held-out evaluation of the trained candidate on RRP2-DEV-V2, RRP2-DEV-V1 and RRP2-PRES-DEV at a 4096 evaluation window qualified in-run. No model selection among variants, no RL, no teacher, no release.
sizing_is_measured_not_guessed: 726 updates at the RRP-001-measured ~3.7 s per update is roughly 45 minutes of training, plus about 30 minutes of held-out evaluation over 1,488 rows and 11 minutes of in-training probes. The ceiling covers about two such attempts. A first arm is a DOSE PROBE that must be able to fail cheaply, not a two-hour commitment on a host where host RAM is the binding constraint.

training_data.known_limitation: a bucket short of the request has no more rows that fit 2048. evidence_chain is the extreme case -- 4 of 887 ANSWER and 9 of 1113 UNKNOWN fit -- so the arm barely sees it and NO per-family claim about that family will be interpretable.
training_data.source: forge_v2 data/rl/train, stratified by family x status

what_training_permission_actually_gates: Per CL-049 this field gates 'engineering-budget approval is present', which every grant needs. Unlike the measurement lanes, this grant ALSO genuinely permits training: processed_training_tokens_all_attempts is nonzero and 'training' is absent from excludes. Both changes are deliberate and are the substance of this grant.
